title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in lists (Created / Updated by) – Display data audit fields without customization
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) introduces visual avatars in list pages to display which user or agent created or modified records, eliminating the need for customization to show creator and modifier identity information.
key_points: Avatars appear in list view layouts without requiring page customization, indicating record creators and modifiers
Feature supports named users, system users, and AI agents following BC's existing identity model
Hovering over avatars shows tooltip with full display name and record timestamp
Users can toggle the Created/Updated by column on or off via view layout options
Benefits teams working with shared data by reducing verification time for ownership and responsibility
features: Avatars for record creators and modifiers
Tooltip with display name and timestamp

quotes.text: Users can hover over the avatar to see a tooltip with the full display name and record update timestamp (if available).
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how users can quickly access detailed information without opening the record, improving efficiency
